- It can exfoliate skin both on the surface and in the pores
- It's a potent anti-inflammatory agent
- It's more effective for treating blackheads than acne

ingredients.name: 10% Niacinamide
ingredients.shortDesc: Improves skin elasticity and inhibits melanosome transfer which helps fade marks
ingredients.longDesc:
Quick Facts:
- A multi-functional skincare superstar with several proven benefits for the skin
- Great anti-aging, wrinkle smoothing ingredient
- Fades brown spots alone or in combination with amino sugar, acetyl glucosamine
- Can help to improve several skin conditions including acne, hyperpigmentation

description:
Say goodbye to  body acne and stubborn scars  with this powerful duo!  Salicylic Acid fights breakouts, while  Niacinamide fades marks and evens skin tone—so you can enjoy clearer, smoother skin all over.

This Kit Contains:

🛁  1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash  – Unclogs pores, fights body acne & prevents new breakouts.

🧴 10%  Niacinamide Body Lotion – Fades acne scars, brightens skin & strengthens the barrier.

❌You will not see results in just 1 month

✅ Use twice daily for 3 months for best results🗓️.

Step 1: Apply adequate amount of bodywash on wet skin. Rinse and pat dry
Step 2: Post shower, apply the moisturiser all over the body

howToUse:
Step 1: Apply adequate amount of bodywash on wet skin. Rinse and pat dry
Step 2: Post shower, apply the moisturiser all over the body

faqs.question: How long must I use this pack to see results?
faqs.answer: You will notice visible reduction in body acne with 2-3 months of use. With ethe bdy acne marks : changes depend on the severity of the condition but most people see a change within 3 months of usage.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of this pack?
faqs.answer: There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time.

faqs.question: What else can I use with this pack?
faqs.answer: In case you have active acne - post shower you can use a gel/spray over the acne before using the lotion.

faqs.question: Why should I use this bodywash?
faqs.answer: Enriched with Salicylic Acid - this is a bodywash that does more- it cleanses your pores, prevent acne formation and also helps gently exfoliate skin.
